events.title: Week 3 Social: Pub Golf
events.description: Welcome to Pub Golf! You will play in teams. No pressure to drink; fun, friendly competition for those who do. Free attendance event. Feel free to pair up (you can buy two tickets per order); otherwise, you can decide your pairs on the day. The concept: We will go to 9 bars and order a drink. Each bar will have a different type of drink, e.g. beer, cider, etc... The aim is to finish your drink in the least amount of sips (exactly like playing golf). The team with the lowest score wins! Each pub will have different challenges, and we will have general game rules too! Meet time: 6pm at Pendle Witch (get there early to start as soon as possible) Game rules: Trip +1 Mention anything work-related +1 Water hazards (Toilet trips) (see below) +2 Break bar rules (see below) +2 Minor spillage +1; Dropped drink +4 Decking it +3 Unfinished drink +3 Drink forfeit + 4 Kicked out bar +7 Chunder +10 Cheating +10 Drinking Holes, bar games and drinks!! Hole 1. Pendle Witch - Post-drink interview (social media content) - Cider - Par 2 Hole 2. Spoons - Do not say yes or no (gestures count too) - Wine - Water Hazard - Par 2 Hole 3. Ring O’Bells - No hands (partner holds drink) - Beer - Par 3 Hole 4. Staggered Inn - No Phones - Mixer - Par 1 Hole 5. The Pub - Balance shuttlecock on your head - Water break / soft drink - Par 1 Hole 6. Spoons - Left Hand Only - Buzz Golf Balls - Water hazard - Par 2 Hole 7. Greens - Team drinks relays (losers' score is doubled) - Alco-pop e.g. VK - Par 2 Hole 8. Molly O’Malley’s - Baby Guinness shot - Water hazard - Par 1 Hole 9. Generations - Corky's shot or Jäger Bomb - Par 1 Please be aware that our social media exec will be making some people do reels :)

We invite you to come along to our Careers Workshop with
Ian Newman. Ian graduated from Lancaster University with an Economics
and Politics degree. He’s been a Career Mentor on the University’s Career

events.title: Surgical Skills 101 - Suturing - Session 2
events.description: Surgical Skills 101: The Basics of Suturing and OR Conduct - Session 2 Join the Richard Owen Society for our second session as part of the Surgical Skills 101 series. This will be a two-hour, hands-on introduction to operating theatre etiquette and suturing (simple, continuous and mattress sutures) We'll start with the basics of the OR: sterile zones, scrubbing, who's who in the theatre team, and how medical students are expected to conduct themselves. Then you'll learn and practise different suturing techniques. Each technique begins with a short demonstration, then supervised practice with facilitators and a consultant on hand to give feedback and correct common errors. We'll finish by comparing the two techniques and discussing suture choice and wound types. By the end of the session, you'll be able to: Show correct OR etiquette and identify team roles Choose suitable suture and needle types for basic closures Perform interrupted, continuous and mattress sutures on synthetic models Explain wound tension principles and the reasoning behind suture selection.

events.title: Lancaster Sail Week 2027
events.description: LUSC x ARMADA WEEK GREECE ⛵☀️ Get ready for a week of sun, sailing, island hopping and unforgettable nights as Lancaster University Sailing Club heads to Greece for Armada Week ! We’ll be setting sail from Athens and spending the week exploring the Greek islands as part of a huge flotilla of yachts. Expect crystal-clear water, secluded swimming spots, beautiful harbours and plenty of time to relax in the sun during the day, followed by organised events, bars and parties in a different destination each night. Across the week, we’ll sail between destinations including Agia Marina, Perdika, Ermioni, Dokos and Poros , stopping off at coves and anchorages along the way. There’ll be everything from beach activities and sunset drinks to raft parties, fancy dress and big nights out — all alongside other crews taking part in Armada Week. You don’t need to be an experienced sailor to come along. Each yacht has a skipper responsible for getting the boat safely between destinations, so this is as much a summer holiday and social as it is a sailing trip. Whether you’re coming for the sailing, Greek sunshine, swimming, nightlife, or just a ridiculous week away with LUSC, this is set to be one of the highlights of the year. Think Greek islands + yacht week ⛵🍻 More details on dates, travel, prices and how to secure your place will be announced by the club. Armada Week itinerary: https://www.armada-week.com/en-gb/aboutweekgreece
